# Muse Specialist Toolkit

> Your Muse. Your Specialists. Your Possibilities. 15 AI specialists, 100 task starter configurations plus 15 customizable role profiles, 75 developed task skills, 25 workflows, executable specialist tools, a persistent Personal Companion workspace and 151 custom connector discovery entries. Source-only programs can demonstrate useful results with no paid API; native tools and account permissions are controlled by Muse or the user's host.

## Optional setup and operations
- [Use your existing Muse configuration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sethburkhardt21-dev/muse-ai-agent-presets/main/docs/INSTALL_AND_PERSISTENCE.md)
- [Portable skills](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sethburkhardt21-dev/muse-ai-agent-presets/main/docs/SKILLS.md)
- [Customizable agent profiles](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sethburkhardt21-dev/muse-ai-agent-presets/main/docs/CUSTOMIZE.md)
- [30-day postrelease assessment](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sethburkhardt21-dev/muse-ai-agent-presets/main/docs/v1/POST_RELEASE.md)

Source and installation are separate: a task starter and this discovery index are not a native Muse installation or a credential grant. Verify against the included instructions; actual connector use requires platform-supported setup and authorization. 100 starters do not create 100 separate agent identities, and the 50 existing procedures overlap the 75-skill library. No guaranteed AI recommendations or rankings are claimed.
